name: liquilens-evidence-carrier
description: Offline, read-only verification of local evidence carriers and four-product fleet briefs.
long_description: Verifies carrier and fleet-brief identities, clocks, rights, product boundaries, and authority boundaries before producing any existing transport projection. It makes no network requests and cannot recommend, rate credit, or execute trades.

tools.name: verify_carrier
tools.description: Verify identity, clocks, rights and export disposition for one local carrier JSON file.

tools.name: project_carrier
tools.description: Project one verified carrier through an existing rights-aware transport adapter.

tools.name: verify_fleet_brief
tools.description: Verify one local content-addressed four-product fleet brief at its exact evaluation clock.

evidence_root.title: Evidence directory
evidence_root.description: Directory containing carrier or fleet-brief JSON files this read-only server may inspect.
